Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage, ruled mechanically: the project's line and the reply's agree on every input triage ran (4037 values compared, none different or missing: 1987 on 1987 fixture cases, 500 on 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1550 on 1550 partial records; policy executable-triage-v2). No agent read the source; one in 10 such disagreements is held for adjudication instead.

Ruling: model error; as in the earlier landing and goal-1 rulings, the reply's screen keeps only reservist, military move, performer, Archer MSA, reforestation and attorney-fee items and leaves out the personal-property rental (scope.rent_personal_if_rental, which this merge put in place of scope.rental), K-1, farm, clergy/church employee, W-2 marks (statutory employee) and other self-employed plan items the project refuses (i1040se p. 1, "Use Schedule E (Form 1040) to report income or loss from rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations"; i1040sf p. 2; i1040sse p. 1, Ministers and Employees of Churches; i1040gi p. 25, statutory employees). Every operand of the reply is in the project's list, so the reply can be true only where the project is: triage (pass 4be1d7385eb3) 4,134/4,499 agree; 48 value differences, all on refused returns (project true, reply false); 279 project-unknown on incomplete/refused partial records; 38 candidate-unknown (27 on completed returns: the reply reads scope.artist_official and others without their gates). Like the project, the reply leaves NOL and recoveries out (now computed: s1.nol_amount_if_nol, rec). Project stands.

Ruling: model error; the reply keeps only wages with no form (scope.pay_no_w2 and scope.wages_no_form) and excess deferrals, and leaves out nonresident status (named in the label), chapter 11, reservist repayments, adoption and other dependent care benefits, disaster distributions and passive losses, which the project refuses (i1040gi p. 8, "Most nonresident aliens and dual-status aliens have different filing requirements"; p. 23, Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Cases; p. 95, Line 20; i2441 p. 5, Lines 12 and 13; i8915f p. 2; i8582 p. 1). Its omission of household, contractor, tips, strike and Medicaid pay agrees with the project, which now computes them (lines 1b, 1c, 1d, 1g, 1h). Triage (pass 4be1d7385eb3): 4,207/4,499 agree; 34 value differences, all on refused returns; 212 project-unknown on incomplete/refused partial records; 46 candidate-unknown (34 completed: scope.excess_deferral read without its W-2 gate). Project stands.
